page.overview:
Who is Boggi Da Squealin' Gobbo of Luck?

Boggi Da Squealin' Gobbo of Luck is a particularly stunted Goblin who, for whatever reason, seems so unnaturally lucky that he is almost invulnerable. As a result, he has become one of the most renowned figures amongst the various Greenskin tribes spreading over the isle of Albion.

From inauspicious beginnings, Boggi has proven to be one of the most renowned figures amongst the various Orc and Goblin tribes spreading over the isle of Albion. A particularly stunted Greenskin, he was abused and tormented by his Goblin brethren, and tragically, if there were enough of them around, he was even taunted by Snotlings.

Unhappily, he found himself heading across the seas aboard one of the vessels in the Orcish fleet, Human ships that had been "acquired". Several days into the journey, he began to enjoy himself, chasing and eating the rats that had taken up residence aboard, and avoiding the kicks of the brutal Orcs who were getting frustrated and increasingly aggressive within the confines of the ship.

With dismay, Boggi realised that the journey was soon to come to an end, and he cowered in the darkest corner within the bowels of the ship, hoping not to be noticed. Unfortunately, the slavering wolves held in their pen within the hull growled at him continuously until he was discovered and dragged onto the deck above. There, he was promptly handed a rotten, wooden shield and a rusted, crumbling sword.
